visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a beige long-sleeved knit sweater and a dark grey pleated mini-skirt, stands in a brightly lit room in front of an open wooden closet filled with hanging clothes. She smiles widely at the camera, raising one arm in an enthusiastic greeting. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a wooden drawer filled with various bras in different colors (black, white, beige, green). A pair of manicured hands reaches into the drawer and pulls out a dark green lace bra. (3) The woman holds up a white paper shopping bag containing more lingerie items, looking directly at the lens with a joyful expression. (4) In a medium shot, she holds the dark green lace bra close to the camera, showcasing the white price tag that reads 'C70' and 'NT$1980'. She gestures toward it with her other hand, pointing out details in the lace. (5) She is now sitting cross-legged on the floor in front of the closet. Several sets of lingerie are spread out around her. She holds the green set (bra and matching panties) towards the lens, waving them slightly to demonstrate the fabric's texture. (6) She picks up two more sets, one black and one cream-colored, showing the tags still attached to the panties to prove they are unused. She holds them up at shoulder height. (7) She leans forward and picks up an intricate black lace set, examining the fine mesh and floral patterns closely. (8) The woman remains sitting, holding the black lace bra while gesturing with her hands as if telling a story, her facial expressions shifting from curiosity to a bright smile. (9) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a pink, rectangular supplement sachet in front of the woman's back as she walks away from the camera. She is wearing blue jeans in this brief shot. (10) A graphic outro appears with a circular frame containing a photo of the woman wearing glasses, surrounded by social media handles and colorful stickers.

(2) A 'ding' bell SFX punctuates the mention of new clothes. The female voice maintains a friendly, slightly rapid delivery. Background noise is a very faint room tone. (3) Sound of plastic rustling and a stinger SFX as the speaker mentions paper bags. The music continues with a steady four-on-the-floor beat. (4) Multiple quick 'dings' and cartoonish pops as the size and price are mentioned. Pitch variability is high, indicating excitement. (5) Transition whoosh as the perspective shifts to the floor. The voice becomes more conversational but retains high energy. (6) Repetitive rhythmic SFX sync with the text appearing on screen. The speaker's articulation is clear and professional. (7) A comedic 'boing' SFX as she jokes about the supplement. The BGM ducks slightly to emphasize the punchline. (8) Strategic use of a 'rewind' SFX before starting the storytelling phase. The vocal tone becomes more narrative and warm. (9) Soft percussive hits in the BGM emphasize key points in the story about the New York trip. (10) Outro music swells in brightness. Final bell chime as the screen fades. SNR remains high throughout.

The creator shares a personal, humorous anecdote about her husband's reaction to a specific Victoria's Secret set to create a sense of intimacy and relatability while showing off the items' quality.
